messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "avoid taking with fruit juices or vitamin C at the same time"
set: ["avoid taking with fruit juices or vitamin C at the same time", "take with food at the same time each day", "take at around the same time each day", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "take at same time each day", "take at same time every day", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "do not use different brands of semaglutide at the same time", "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals", "not recommended to take 2 cyclobenzaprine 10 mg at the same time", "may be repeated at the same dose", "extended-release capsules are taken once daily at about the same time each day", "may be taken with or without food, but take it the same way each time", "can be given with or without meals at any time of the day", "take prescribed dose every four to six hours at the same time every day", "mix powder form with at least 4 ounces (one-half cup) of cold water or fruit juice before taking"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
